svg.title: Equal steps: added amounts and multiplied amounts
svg.desc: On equal input steps of 1 from x = 0 to x = 5, the line f(x) = 4 + 6x (green) adds 6 each step: 4, 10, 16, 22, 28, 34. The exponential g(x) = 4(1.5)^x (blue) multiplies by 1.5 each step: 4, 6, 9, 13.5, 20.25, 30.375, and passes the line between x = 5 and x = 6.
